verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents no user-definable rule engine where a user sets event conditions that automatically trigger actions. The webhooks are a developer building block: they send event notifications that an external app must act on. The bank-reconciliation "automated workflows" and Bill Pay scheduled payments are adjacent, fixed automations or schedules rather than user-defined event-triggered rules, so none of this earns credit for the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
